_note: Held-out evaluation suite. Fully synthetic and generated from a fixed seed, so these results are reproducible. The generation distribution is declared in '_distribution' below so a reader can judge whether the suite is fair. It is deliberately NOT filtered to favour scenarios where the constraint layer helps.

_distribution.flood_severity_per_cell: uniform 0.0-1.0, independent per cell -- NOT a gradient, so shelter safety is uncorrelated with distance except by chance
_distribution.deliberate_edge_cases: the suite is post-filtered ONLY to guarantee coverage of three regimes: scenarios where every shelter is unsafe, scenarios where every shelter is safe, and scenarios where the constraint layer changes nothing. It is NOT filtered to favour scenarios where the constraint layer helps.
